div.div: 5 تضمّخ بِالطِّيبِ , (S, A, Mgh, Msb, K,) and ↓ انضمخ , and ↓ اِضْطَمَخَ , (K,) and ↓ اِضَّمَخَ , (L,) He daubed or smeared himself, or he became daubed or smeared, (S, A, Mgh, Msb, K,) copiously, (L,) with perfume, (S, A, Mgh, Msb, K,) so that it seemed to drip. (L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
